title: NAMC National Conference: one site to attend, sponsor and exhibit
summaryLead: The 2027 national conference site for the NAMC Wisconsin Chapter, built from the 2026 B2B Forum site.
story: NAMC Wisconsin hosts the 58th National Conference in Milwaukee, June 28 to 30, 2027. Their earlier forum site was text and links: the schedule and the map sat behind separate buttons, and sponsor tiers were mentioned without much weight. The new site starts with one question, what are you here to do? Attend, sponsor or exhibit, each with its price on the card. Everything after that, from the city to the keynote to the sponsor levels, supports one of those three choices.
goals: Ask visitors what they came to do, and send them there.
Put prices on the first screen: $400 early bird, $5,000 to $50,000 sponsor levels, $1,500 booths.
Put dates, venue and gala pricing in one view, with Register and Add to Calendar.
